overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the executive session topic on non-affiliated staff contracts was specific enough, and no contract was negotiated so none had to be disclosed in open session. A footnote cautioned that salary discussions resembling budget talk belong in open session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the September 21, 2015 notice's executive session topic (non-affiliated staff contracts) lacked enough detail about the subject discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that this topic sufficiently described the anticipated executive session such that the public had sufficient information to decide whether to attend the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to disclose a personnel contract in open session after the executive session.
allegations.key_passage: it did not negotiate any contract during this meeting and therefore there was no executed contract to disclose in open session following the executive session.
